content.title: The ‘Beef’ Season 2 Cast Makes Up One Big Dysfunctional Work Family
content.text: 1Oscar Isaac plays Josh MartinNetflixJosh is the general manager of a country club.Isaac is a Golden Globe winning as well as Independent Spirit and SAG award nominated actor for shows like Show Me A Hero, Scenes From A Marriage, and films like Inside Llewyn Davis and Frankenstein. He starred in Alex Garland’s Ex Machina and A Most Violent Year as well. You might also know him as the titular Moon Knight from the Marvel series, Timmy’s dad in Dune, or as Poe Dameron in the Star Wars sequel movies. He’s also a stage actor and was nominated for a Tony Award in 2023 for The Sign in Sidney Brustein’s Window.IG: @oscarisaac (Isaac’s wife @elvira_lind_ is also a great follow!)2Carey Mulligan plays Lindsay Crane MartinNetflixLindsay is the club’s interior decorator and Josh’s wife.Mulligan has worked with Isaac before on two other occasions: Inside Llewyn Davis and Drive. But she’s even better known for her Academy Award nominated performances in An Education, Promising Young Woman, and Maestro as well as Mudbound, The Great Gatsby, Shame, She Said, and Far from the Madding Crowd. On the television front, she was in a famous episode of Doctor Who called “Blink” and the BBC miniseries adaptation of Charles Dickens’ Bleak House. She was also nominated for a Tony, in 2015, NBD.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below3Charles Melton plays Austin DavisNetflixAustin is a personal trainer and Ashley’s new fiancé.Melton went from taking Reggie Mantle to some wild new places on the final season of Riverdale to critical acclaim and a Golden Globe nomination for his supporting role in Todd Haynes’ May December. He played the lead in the 2019 romance The Sun Is Also a Star. Melton is in a great episode of Poker Face as well, and Garland’s It Boy ensemble film Warfare. In 2026, you can see him in the already buzzy Nicolas Winding Refn film Her Private Hell.IG: @meltonWhat Everyone's Reading 👀4Cailee Spaeny plays Ashley MillerNetflixAshley is a “cart girl” a.k.a. a bartender on the golf course.Like Melton, Spaeny also starred in a Garland film, Civil War. She has been on a roll lately as well, with Wake Up Dead Man, Alien: Romulus, and of course Priscilla–which earned her a Golden Globe nomination. You might remember her from Bad Times at the El Royale, On The Basis of Sex, or Mare of Eastown as well. Her upcoming roles include the romance Deep Cuts with Drew Starkey and Ariela Barer as well as a live-action Elden Ring film.IG: @caileespaenyAdvertisement - Continue Reading Below5Youn Yuh-jung plays Chairwoman ParkNetflixChairwoman Park is the new owner of the country club.Youn is an icon of Korean film with more awards than you can count whose credits include Woman on Fire, The Housemaid, The Bacchus Lady, Canola, The Taste of Money, and Dog Days. In 2021 she crossed the ocean to star in Lee Isaac Chung’s Minari, and walked away with a BAFTA, SAG, Independent Spirit and Academy Award. Piece of cake! You might also recognize her from recent roles including the 2025 remake of The Wedding Banquet and the Apple TV+ series Pachinko.6Song Kang-ho plays Dr. KimNetflixKim is Chairwoman Park’s husband and a surgeon.Song is perhaps best known to Western audiences for his collaborations with Director Bong, a.k.a. Bong Joon-ho, in films that include the Best Picture winner Parasite, Snowpiercer, and The Host. He is also an iconic and incredibly influential Korean film star. His award-winning performances include the films Memories of Murder, Broker, Taxi Driver, Secret Sunshine, The Show Must Go On, The Attorney, and Thirst. He also recently starred in the Hulu series Uncle Samsik.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below7Seoyeon Jang plays EuniceNetflixEunice is Chairwoman Park’s interpreter and assistant.Prior to Beef, Korean actress Seyeon had recurring roles in Good Partner and Butterfly and appeared in other shows like Emergency Declaration, Love is for Suckers, and Snowdrop.IG: @seoyeonrebecca8William Fichtner plays TroyNetflixTroy is a country club member in a relationship with Ava.Last year, Fichtner played an eccentric (when are they not) vampire on the Interview with the Vampire spin-off Talamasca: The Secret Order. His television credits include The Company You Keep, Mom, Entourage, Prison Break, and As The World Turns. He was on the latter for 79 episodes over almost ten years! On the big screen, you’ve also seen him in Strange Days, Heat, Crash, Armageddon, Pearl Harbor, The Longest Yard and Black Hawk Down.Advertisement - Continue Reading Below9Mikaela Hoover plays AvaNetflixAva is a member at the club.Hoover was a scene-stealer as Cat Grant in 2025’s Superman and has worked with James Gunn on other films that include Guardians of the Galaxy vol. 3 and The Suicide Squad. She is part of the One Piece cast on Netflix, playing Tony Tony Chopper.IG: @mikaela10Matthew Kim plays WooshNetflixWoosh is a tennis instructor at the club.Matthew Kim is also a rapper and vocal artist known as Big Matthew or BM and a member of the co-ed group Kard. This is his first major acting role!IG: @bigmatthewww Um, is love officially over? Get the latest news on every celebrity split when you sign up for Cosmo’s newsletter. Woo! That was easy. Welcome to the club, bb.
